correctness.rationale: The explicit generating facets, unique-center lemmas from girth >=5, ordered free-face matchings, exactly described core, connected crown-edge relation graph, unimodular relative CW cancellation, and graph-of-spaces assembly establish the claimed nonequivariant *integral* homotopy equivalence for all connected finite bases with no 3- or 4-cycles and all m>=4. Row boundaries S^(m-2) are simply connected. Two-stage pair count is exact. A standalone verifier reconstructs 19 finite cases from adjacency, tests all 6844 elementary collapse pairs, verifies core and interface relations, and independently computes mod-two Betti ranks; finite checks are corroboration rather than the universal proof.
